chunks: Ibn Fazzal, from one of our companions, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said:
ai.seo_question: What is the effect of kohl on sexual intercourse according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) states that applying kohl increases sexual desire or potency during intercourse (mubad'ah). This hadith, found in al-Kulayni’s *al-Kafi*, reflects the pre-modern medical understanding in Shia tradition that topical treatments could influence internal physiological states, linking physical care with marital intimacy. It underscores the holistic view of health in Shia jurisprudence, where aesthetic and medicinal practices are seen as enhancing natural faculties.

en.hubeali:
Ibn Fazzal, from one of our companions, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
’ The Kohl increased in the copulation’.
en.sarwar: 8. Ibn Faddal has narrated from certain persons of our people who have said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Applying eye powder increases the desire to go to bed with ones’ wife.’”
